This algorithm can be applied to noise reduction in commercial image- or video-based applications such as digital cameras and digital television (DTV) for its performance and simplicity.

articleTitle: On the design of a sound system for a mobile audio unit
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: A mobile audio unit is a wireless, battery-driven unit, the main purpose of which is to reproduce acoustic signals. This kind of unit can be used in conjunction with a home server. For example, a radio station broadcasting can be received from the Internet and fed to the mobile audio unit via a central home server. The market for home servers is expected to grow leading to a possible expansion of the market for this type of mobile audio unit. This paper presents some design aspects for the sound system of an audio unit, adapted to the new demands of the market.

articleTitle: A portable camcorder/server for wireless video transmission
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: A new camcorder with a wireless LAN and a server function was successfully developed. This enables handy network communication with the camcorder by a wireless method and direct access to recording/recorded data of the camcorder from other equipment through easy user operations. We further investigate the higher network speed and user interface for much easier operation.

articleTitle: A novel low power pulse width modulation vision sensor with handshaking read-out strategy
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: A novel vision sensor based on pulse width modulation scheme and asynchronous communication protocol is presented. The pixel includes only 20 transistors and occupies an area of 18.5 /spl times/ 18.5 /spl mu/m/sup 2/, with a fill factor of 23% using 0.35 /spl mu/m CMOS process.

articleTitle: Enhanced-xVSB system development for mobile/portable reception
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: The paper describes an enhanced-xVSB system for improving mobile/pedestrian reception performance to the ATSC DTV 8-VSB transmission standard. The proposed system is fully backward compatible with the current ATSC 8-VSB standard. For mobile and portable reception support, the E-xVSB system adopts a reduced constellation method as well as an enhanced trellis-coded modulation scheme.

articleTitle: New first subfield waveform for improving low gray level linearity in AC-plasma display panel
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: A new first subfield waveform is proposed to enhance the low gray level linearity in AC-PDP. The proposed first subfield uses a ramp pulse instead of a square sustain pulse, thereby generating the lower minimum-luminance level stably and reducing the low gray level contour.

articleTitle: Modulation level detection scheme for sub-band adaptive OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: Sub-band adaptive OFDM is a modulation technique in which the OFDM transmitter adapts a different modulation level according to channel conditions. In order to successfully demodulate the transmit data symbols, the receiver has to have reliable prior knowledge to the modulation level. This information can either be conveyed as a signaling symbol or the receiver can attempt to estimate the parameters employed at the transmitter by means of a blind detection mechanism. This work proposes a novel modulation level detection scheme which uses the adaptively modulated data symbols. The blind modulation level estimation scheme is coupled with MAP decoding process in order to improve the detection performance.

articleTitle: A digital watermark scheme using bits operation
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: The work presents the design of a digital watermark scheme based on DCT; it has the advantages of imperceptibility and robustness achieved by grouping every watermark bit in a group and changing only one coefficient each time in turn. The simulation result shows that the performance of the proposed algorithm is better than that of other algorithms.

articleTitle: Tree LDPC codes for IEEE 802.16 broadband wireless Internet
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: This work presents a new tree-LDPC code, which has a structured parity check matrix, in the application of IEEE 802.16 broadband wireless Internet. The proposed tree-LDPC code shows better performance with low encoding complexity compared to the regular LDPC codes and RA codes.

articleTitle: An ultra-small high-performance silicon microphone using single-crystalline silicon
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: We have developed a prototype of an ultra-small high-performance condenser-type silicon microphone with a unique semiconductor microfabrication technology using extremely high-tensile-strength single-crystalline silicon, having both mass producibility and outstanding reliability. The microphone we fabricated has such acoustic characteristics as a wide frequency range of 30 Hz to 20 kHz, sensitivity of over -42 dB, and wide dynamic range of 134 dB/sub SPL/, sufficient for broadcasting and consumer use.

articleTitle: Slow motion replay of video sequences using fractal zooming
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: The purpose of This work is to present a technique combining fractals and wavelet transform to obtain a selectively pleasant zoom and slow motion of digital video sequences. Active scene detection and post processing are used to reduce computational cost and improve visual quality respectively.

articleTitle: Mobile multimedia DRM (digital rights management) for hand-held devices
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: Mobile multimedia streaming applications have been widely propagated with the rapid evolution of mobile handsets, especially MPEG-4 video streams over wireless communication networks. We propose an efficient encryption scheme on the media data that are encoded with MPEG-4 video format. We constructed 4 methods, namely the encryption of I-, P-, B-VOPs (video object planes) and a combination of these three types of encryption. They are designed for DRM services on a mobile multimedia streaming system without performance degradation that could be a burden to a mobile handset. We report the competitiveness of these methods from the perspective of performance evaluation with respect to plain MPEG-4 files.

articleTitle: Fast multi-resolution motion estimation algorithm and its VLSI architecture
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: This work presents a fast multi-resolution block-matching algorithm (FMRME) for MPEG-2 video encoding, which provides an outstanding PSNR performance close to the full search algorithm. We also propose the hardware architecture of the FMRME for real-time MPEG-2 video encoding with a large search range of [-192.0, +191.5]. Due to efficient data reuse and parallel processing, the utilization percentage of PE is also very high. We implemented this architecture with about 100 K gates and 5 K bytes SPSRAM.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of telephone-initiated multimedia healthcare embedded system for senior residents
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: Today healthcare systems are mainly used to provide e-healthcare services in the hospital domain. We implement a multimedia healthcare embedded system that uses the telephone connected to the homeserver to initiate a multimedia communication to the hospital network using the session initiation protocol (SIP). This work illustrates our implementation of the e-healthcare service for consumer electronic devices using the conventional telephone to assist senior residents.

articleTitle: H.264 video codec for HDTV terrestrial transmission
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: We investigate the effectiveness of the data partitioning approach in H.264 for HDTV terrestrial transmission with Reed Solomon (RS) and turbo codes. Results show that the equal error protection (EEP) scheme provides the best video quality at low SNR values and at high SNR, EEP and unequal error protection (UEP1and UEP2) schemes provide the best video quality. Therefore, it can be concluded that the data partitions defined in H.264 are not suitable if used for HDTV terrestrial broadcasting.

articleTitle: ICCE 2005 luncheon keynote address
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: Provides an abstract of the keynote presentation and a brief professional biography of the presenter. The complete presentation was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Software-only multiple variable length decoding for real-time video on MDSP
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: We present the multiple variable length decode algorithm implemented in most video applications on MDSP. In our implementations we were able to decode multiple symbols per cycle. The implementation is efficient and is targeted towards memory constrained embedded systems. We have confirmed this algorithm in our implementations of H261/3, MPEG2/4 and achieved multifold speedup improvements against algorithms which can decode at the symbol rate only. This limits the decoding throughput capability of these algorithms. Most parallel decoding approaches use the length of the first codeword to detect the second codeword in parallel. By a single table lookup operation we detect multiple codewords without any detection mechanism.

articleTitle: A CMOS front-end LSI with a CTC for Blu-ray disc system
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: A CMOS front-end LSI for the Blu-ray disc system including a crosstalk canceller, an adaptive tangential equalizer, a limit-equalizer, a Viterbi decoder was developed. It contains about 1M gates and operates up to 3/spl times/ speed and performs to improve tolerances of the system.

articleTitle: Managing mechanism for service compatibility and interaction issues in context-aware ubiquitous home
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: We discuss interaction issues about conflicts and interference between various context information and services in the ubiquitous home environment. Context information conflicts occur when classifying services based on various sensing information. Service interactions are generated when services are applied in different controls simultaneously for the same device. In order to solve the problem, the paper utilizes a context-aware based service mechanism for interaction management.

articleTitle: Wireless embedded networks: connectivity for everyday objects
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: The work presents wireless embedded network architectures, how they are used and how they differ from conventional wireless LAN systems such as IEEE 802.11. It also describes the advantages of using self-organizing, self-healing mesh architecture to implement wireless embedded networks for common manufactured goods.

articleTitle: Middleware for isochronous connection management in IEEE1394-IEC61883 based multimedia home network
publicationTitle: 2005 Digest of Technical Papers. International Conference on Consumer Electronics, 2005. ICCE.
abstract: For efficient management of isochronous resources and of connection of an entire IEEE1394 network, a management architecture and interface are required. The paper proposes a middleware for isochronous connection management in IEEE1394-IEC61883 based multimedia home networks.
